Kosovo's Former President Thaci Sentenced to 25 Years for War Crimes

Hashim Thaçi, the former president of Kosovo, has been sentenced to 25 years in prison by a war crimes court in The Hague. Thaçi was convicted of war crimes and illegal detention. The sentencing follows his conviction for crimes committed during and immediately after the 1998-1999 Kosovo War. The court's decision has reportedly sparked mass protests in Kosovo.
